metadata.title: FAQ
metadata.description: Answers about Bharosa Hai provider onboarding, customer launch, verification and current MVP scope.

hero.title: Everything early customers and providers should know.
hero.copy: Answers about provider onboarding, verification, customer launch, admin review and current Tier 1 MVP boundaries.
hero.imageAlt: Professional team reviewing a FAQ document

section.title: Clear answers, no overpromising.
section.copy: This FAQ keeps the current scope honest: provider onboarding and dashboard surfaces are in; customer requests, leads, payments and subscriptions are not.

items.question: What is Bharosa Hai?
items.answer: Bharosa Hai is a verification-first platform for high-trust professional services such as legal, CA, GST, property, documentation and government-service support.

items.question: Is the client access live?
items.answer: Not yet. The client access is currently a coming-soon experience while provider onboarding is prepared.

items.question: Can customers submit service requests now?
items.answer: No. Customer requests and lead management are outside the current Tier 1 MVP scope.

items.question: Who can become a provider?
items.answer: Lawyers, CAs, GST consultants, property advisors, documentation experts and local service professionals can apply.

items.question: Is provider registration free?
items.answer: Yes. Registration is free during the founding provider launch phase.

items.question: Does registration guarantee approval?
items.answer: No. Admins can approve, reject or request more documents.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: Requirements depend on provider category. Examples include Aadhaar, PAN, Bar Council Certificate, ICAI Certificate, business registration and professional credentials.

items.question: Why does verification matter?
items.answer: The supported categories involve sensitive documents, money, property or legal decisions. Verification improves the customer’s starting point.

items.question: Which cities are covered first?
items.answer: The launch focus is Mathura, Vrindavan and nearby districts.

items.question: Will Bharosa Hai expand to other cities?
items.answer: Yes, expansion is planned after the first provider network and operating model are stable.

items.question: Can I suggest a city?
items.answer: Yes. You can contact the team with city or category suggestions.

items.question: What happens after provider registration?
items.answer: The profile and documents are reviewed by admins. The provider dashboard can show the current verification status.

items.question: Can providers edit their profiles?
items.answer: The dashboard currently presents the planned profile-management surface. Full backend editing is not part of this frontend-only scope.

items.question: Are payments available?
items.answer: No. Payments and subscriptions are intentionally not included in the current scope.

items.question: Are customer reviews available?
items.answer: No. Reviews are planned for a later phase after customer workflows launch.

items.question: Does the admin dashboard work with live data?
items.answer: Not yet. The frontend shows the intended interface, but backend integration is separate.

items.question: How are providers approved?
items.answer: Admins review profile information and uploaded category documents before making a decision.

items.question: Can admins request more documents?
items.answer: The UI includes this action, and the database model supports the state. Full action wiring is backend work for later.

items.question: Is my data safe?
items.answer: The production product should include secure auth, protected access, validated uploads and storage controls before launch.

items.question: Can a provider apply in more than one category?
items.answer: The current registration UI focuses on one primary category to keep onboarding clear.

items.question: What languages are supported?
items.answer: English and Hindi are supported now, and the architecture is ready for more languages.

items.question: Why focus on professionals first?
items.answer: The marketplace needs a trusted provider base before customer workflows can create a reliable experience.

items.question: Is this for businesses or individuals?
items.answer: Both. The categories support individuals, families and small business owners.

items.question: Can I contact support?
items.answer: Yes. Use the contact page for provider, admin-access or early product questions.

items.question: Will there be lead management?
items.answer: Not in this scope. Lead management is reserved for a later phase.
